headline: Two one-day alcohol license applications for Methuen Festival of Trees and an outdoor patio application for Mi Mexico Lindo Restaurant.
summary: The festival's alcohol requests cover events on November 18 and November 20, 2026. The restaurant's patio request would allow food and beverage service outdoors.
items: One-day alcohol license applications for Methuen Festival of Trees, 13 Branch Street
Outdoor patio area for food and beverage service at Mi Mexico Lindo Restaurant, 5 Pleasant Street

Two One-Day Alcohol license applications have been submitted for Methuen Festival of Trees, 13 Branch 
Street Methuen, for events on the dates of November 18, 2026 and November 20, 2026. 
 
An application has been submitted for an Outdoor Patio area for service of food and beverages for Mi Mexico 
Lindo Restaurant at 5 Pleasant Street. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Next meeting will be Wednesday, December 9, 2026.
